name: FCaptcha
description: Self-hosted CAPTCHA widget and server-side verification for web forms.
longDescription:
FCaptcha runs a browser widget and its token verifier on your own server. Use it to protect contact forms and custom signup flows. Deploy a single container, try its bundled demo at /demo/, and verify tokens in your application backend.

The single-instance template stores security state in memory. It requires two distinct user-generated secrets and an HTTPS route for public use.
